Pulse 0.15.0

What's new:
- Local MCP for agents. Turn on Settings → Agents → MCP and Pulse serves Streamable HTTP on your Mac (127.0.0.1 only, Bearer token in the Keychain). Claude, ChatGPT, and any MCP-compatible client can list watchlists and positions, search symbols, create and manage groups, add or remove symbols, record and delete trades, calibrate positions, and reorder groups or custom symbol order — against the same live data you see in the menu bar.
- Settings layout for agents: Appearance moves menu bar and market presentation onto a secondary page, and MCP sits under a dedicated Agents section with connection fields and a short tools summary.

No setup is required after updating. MCP stays off until you enable it. Regenerating the token from the MCP settings page immediately cuts off any client still using the old one.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.15.0.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
